title: Two-qubit teleportation through a noisy channel, corrected from measurement counts: code and data
description: Code, data and notebooks of a study of two-qubit quantum teleportation through a noisy channel whose correction (one parametric gate per channel qubit) is learned from measurement counts only. The package simulates the six-qubit protocol exactly, implements the counts-only calibrators, the ceiling of any correction, process tomography (TOMO-9, TOMO-75) and drift tracking, and rebuilds every result of an experiment on the IBM device ibm_kingston (4 October 2026) from its raw counts, which are included.
